definitions.gloss: first issue; inaugural issue; premiere issue
definitions.explanation: The very first published issue of a magazine, newspaper, journal, or other periodical publication.

examples.japanese: {創刊号|そうかんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I got hold of the first issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創刊号|そうかんごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{1985年|せんきゅうひゃくはちじゅうごねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The first issue of this magazine was published in 1985.

examples.japanese: {創刊号|そうかんごう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{最新号|さいしんごう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えている→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧⟦コレクター→コレクター：20000_korekutaa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are collectors who have every issue from the first to the latest.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{創刊|そうかん}→創刊：11923_soukan⟧ (first publication, founding of a periodical) + {号|ごう} (issue number). Refers specifically to the first edition of a periodical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {創刊号|そうかんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to publish the inaugural issue
- {創刊号|そうかんごう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read from the first issue
- {創刊号|そうかんごう}⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧: first-issue special supplement

RELATED WORDS:
- {最新号|さいしんごう}: the latest issue
- ⟦{休刊|きゅうかん}→休刊：21658_kyuukan⟧: suspension of publication
- {廃刊|はいかん}: discontinuation of publication
- {復刊|ふっかん}: resumption of publication
- ⟦{創刊|そうかん}→創刊：11923_soukan⟧: the act of founding/launching a periodical

USAGE:
{創刊号|そうかんごう} of popular magazines often become valuable collectibles. Many magazines offer special prices or ⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧ (supplements/freebies) with their {創刊号|そうかんごう} to attract initial readers.
